summaryZh: UC San Diego的CS Education Research Lab研究如何改善计算机教育中的学生学习成果，包括评估新教学法、设计学习测评、用机器学习识别学习困难，以及通过课程结构增强共同体感。具体项目涉及生成式AI辅助初级编程、文化相关的计算机教育及学生参与。
researchQuestions: 学生如何在LLM辅助的编程环境中有效学习？
课程设计如何改善学生参与和共同体感？
topics: 计算机教育与学习成果
文化相关教育与学生参与
methods: 机器学习识别学习困难

evidence.quote: CS Education Research Lab at UC San Diego
I am currently affiliated with The CSEd Research Lab in University of California at San Diego.
The CS Education Research (CER) Lab explores ways to improve outcomes for all students interested in studying computing.

Our recent efforts include proposing and evaluating new pedagogies, using machine learning to identify struggling students, designing assessments to measure learning, uncovering the source of student struggles, and creating new course structures to improve sense of community.
We seek to understand how students can best learn in the new LLM-assisted learning environments
